== Remove the GDM Package Group
----
To ensure the gdm3 package group is removed, run the following command:
$ dpkg -l gdm3
The output should begin with:
rc gdm3
Or
dpkg-query: no packages found matching gdm3
      Is it the case that gdm3 has not been removed?
----

discussion:
## Remove the GDM Package Group

By removing the `gdm3` package, the system no longer has GNOME installed.

If X Windows is not installed then the system cannot boot into graphical user mode.
This prevents the system from being accidentally or maliciously booted into a `graphical.target`
mode. To do so, run the following command:


```
$ sudo apt remove gdm3
```

**Rationale:**

Unnecessary service packages must not be installed to decrease the attack surface of the system.
A graphical environment is unnecessary for certain types of systems including a virtualization
hypervisor.

steps.name: Remove the GDM Package Group
steps.shell:
# Remediation is applicable only in certain platforms
if dpkg-query --show --showformat='${db:Status-Status}' 'gdm3' 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^installed$'; then

# CAUTION: This remediation script will remove gdm3
# from the system, and may remove any packages
# that depend on gdm3. Execute this
# remediation AFTER testing on a non-production
# system!


# check wether the package is virtual: if not, remove it.
# if the package is virtual, iterate on providers
#  if a provider is installed, remove it
is_virtual=`apt-cache showpkg "gdm3" | grep -Pzc 'Versions: \n\n'`
if [ $is_virtual = 1 ]; then
    rprovides_line=`apt-cache showpkg "gdm3" | grep -n 'Reverse Provides:' | cut -f1 -d:`
    pkglist=`apt-cache showpkg "gdm3" | tail -n +$(($rprovides_line + 1)) | cut -f1 -d' '`
    for package in $pkglist; do
        not_installed=`apt-cache policy $package | grep -c 'Installed: (none)'`
	if [ $not_installed = 0 ]; then
	    DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=60 remove -y $package
	fi
    done
else
    DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=60 remove -y "gdm3"
fi

else
    >&2 echo 'Remediation is not applicable, nothing was done'
fi
